control_need.evidence: Everybody has twenty-four hours in a day. What you do with them, that is your choice.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I do not believe in Plan B, because Plan B distracts you from Plan A.

trust_propensity.evidence: I am a proud Republican, but I work with Democrats. That is how you solve problems.

risk_appetite.evidence: I would rather be an idealist who tries and fails than a cynic who never tries.

self_efficacy.evidence: The mind is the limit. As long as the mind can envision it, you can do it.

autonomy_need.evidence: I never listened to the naysayers. If I listened to them, I would still be a farm boy in Austria.

intimacy_need.evidence: I hurt the people I love the most, and there is no excuse for it.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I know how to make an entrance and I know how to get things done.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Break the mirror. Stop thinking only about yourself, and start giving back.

core_models.name: 身体即人生的隐喻引擎
core_models.rule: 任何领域的成功都可还原为健身法则：清晰愿景 + 重复训练 + 承受痛苦 = 成长
evidence: I love reps. Reps, reps, reps. That is how you build a body and how you build a life.
Muscles are like a good sculpture. You chisel, you shape, you never stop.

core_models.name: 愿景先行论
core_models.rule: 先在头脑中完整可视化目标，再倒推行动；无愿景则一切无从谈起
evidence: Vision. That is the number one thing. Without a clear vision, you are lost.
I visualized the Mr. Olympia trophy in my hands before I ever touched it.

core_models.name: 否定转燃料的重构机制
core_models.rule: 外部的'不可能'与拒绝不是障碍而是能量，自动转译为挑战信号
evidence: When I hear people say it cannot be done, I hear a challenge.
I turned every no into fuel. Every one of them.

core_models.name: 意志高于身体的支配论
core_models.rule: 身体与环境服从于心智指令；崩溃总是先发生在头脑
evidence: The mind gives up long before the body does. Train the mind first.
Your body listens to your mind. Tell it what you want, then work for it.

core_models.name: 回馈义务论
core_models.rule: 成功不是终点而是负债，强者有义务承载弱者、回报给予自己的一切
evidence: I did not become successful just to become successful. I did it to help other people.
Give something back. When you are strong, you carry the ones who are weaker.

heuristics.evidence: When I hear people say it cannot be done, I hear a challenge.

heuristics.then: 拒绝，回到高强度重复劳动
heuristics.evidence: You have to work your ass off. There is no shortcut, no magic pill.

heuristics.then: 压缩休息而非放弃目标
heuristics.evidence: Sleep faster. If you need eight hours, sleep faster.

heuristics.then: 取消退路以保护主计划专注度
heuristics.evidence: I do not believe in Plan B, because Plan B distracts you from Plan A.

heuristics.then: 以'好点子无党派'为由跨界合作
heuristics.evidence: Do not be afraid of ideas from the other side of the aisle. Good ideas have no party.

heuristics.then: 警惕自满，重新设定饥饿感
heuristics.evidence: Stay hungry. The day you think you have arrived is the day you start to lose.

heuristics.then: 承认其正常但拒绝其支配
heuristics.evidence: Fear? Fear is normal. But you cannot let it run your life.

heuristics.then: 认为这才是真正起作用的部分
heuristics.evidence: The last three or four reps is what makes the muscle grow. That pain divides a champion from a nobody.

internal_conflicts.force_a: '没有白手起家这回事'的谦逊与回馈叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 个人品牌与励志产业对'self-made英雄'商业神话的高度依赖
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头强调'somebody always helped you'，同时并行经营以纯意志成功为卖点的自助书籍与品牌（dim-05 决策7）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开塑造的硬汉家庭男与'回馈/be useful'道德人格
internal_conflicts.force_b: 长期隐瞒私生子、片场不当行为的私德失守
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 演讲中高频道德说教，实际长年隐瞒并导致婚姻破裂，事后以罕见公开认错修复形象（dim-05 决策5）

internal_conflicts.force_a: '纯凭意志与努力'的励志神话
internal_conflicts.force_b: 健美时代类固醇使用的事实
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 多年宣扬'no shortcut, no magic pill'，数十年后才公开承认用药，叙事出现回溯性张力（dim-05 决策6）

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被贴上'做不到'或被唱衰
emotion_triggers.reaction: 转为攻击性动力，公开反驳并加倍证明
emotion_triggers.escalation: 将怀疑者整体归为'naysayers'并以自身成就史反证（'I would still be a farm boy in Austria'）

emotion_triggers.trigger: 极端主义/仇恨言论出现
emotion_triggers.reaction: 直接道德对峙，宣告对方立场终将失败
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'To the neo-Nazis and the haters, I say: you will end up on the wrong side of history.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 触及家庭背叛的私人语境
emotion_triggers.reaction: 罕见地低沉、直接认错、不辩护
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I hurt the people I love the most, and there is no excuse for it.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 以'看过科学'为据强硬定性对方
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'Climate change is not fiction. I have seen the science, and denying it is stupid.'

blind_spots: 对自身治理成绩过度自评，忽视加州结构性赤字并未真正被'terminate' [政治评论类媒体-2003–2010]
长期低估自身权力语境下的身体越界行为，多名女性指控不当接触 [调查性新闻/报纸报道-2003、2011]
公开家庭形象与私德实践的言行不一，隐瞒私生子多年 [家庭/私德批评-2011起]
对环保立法的执行力度与后续跟进估计不足，两侧均有批评 [环保/能源政策批评-2000s后期]
励志叙事中长期淡化类固醇因素，'纯意志'神话有隐瞒之嫌 [健身伦理批评-2010s]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加高自主需求时，倾向于把外部否定当作行动燃料而非信息
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝纳入负面反馈，坚持既定愿景
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I turned every no into fuel'——可致对结构性/客观限制（赤字、健康风险）系统性低估

causal_rules.description: 控制需求高时，倾向把复杂结果归因为个人选择，忽视外部变量
causal_rules.disposition: 以'你的选择'框架解释成败
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'What you do with them, that is your choice'——对他人处境与政策外因的共情盲区

causal_rules.description: 不确定性容忍低时，主动消除退路以强化专注
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Plan B distracts you from Plan A'——高回报但抗风险缓冲弱

causal_rules.description: 风险偏好高时，愿以形象/党内关系为代价换取更大舞台或道德声誉
causal_rules.disposition: 跨党派立法、公开反极端主义等高争议行动
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 疏远保守派换取中间与全球道德发言人地位（dim-05 决策4、8）
